goal: Stop silent discarding of configuration settings assigned multiple times
Alert node operators on startup when duplicate single-value options are detected
agreement: Concept approval because repeated settings can use the allow-list flag (JeremyRubin)
Concern that existing configs could fail to restart on upgrade was resolved (ajtowns)
Approval from an account with no project history and no stated reason (Khailand69)

categories.name: utils
why: P3 because it prevents node operators from assuming an option is active when silently ignored
Fails early on startup instead of relying on unintuitive reverse-precedence rules
